manifest.title: Technomage
manifest.description: Technomage career, talents and spell trees. / Technomage-Laufbahn, Talente und Spell-Trees.

talents.name: Chrysalis
talents.description: You are a novice Technomage and retain your Chrysalis, a personal device that functions as a holo-emitter, tricorder, and communicator. Your mentor can remotely disable or enable your Technomage abilities.

talents.name: FTL-Attunement
talents.description: You have built contacts among crews and specialists who travel faster than light. As with Well-Informed, you can draw on those contacts and the news they share to ask the gamemaster two questions about an FTL situation or location at the start of a scene.

talents.name: Organells
talents.description: Technomage organelles reinforce your body. This talent functions as a Technomage version of Durability: you gain Protection 2.

spells.name: Bubble of Air
spells.sourceDuration: 1 minute (1 round underwater or in a vacuum)

spells.name: Bubble of Air, Group
spells.sourceDuration: 1 minute (1 round underwater or in a vacuum)

spells.name: Elemental Resistance, Lesser
spells.requirements: Lesser Armour, Create Fire/Ice/Acid/Lightning/ Sound (at least one)

spells.name: Force Wall, Medium
spells.sourceTarget: Three adjacent 5-foot squares in a straight line

spells.name: Force Wall, Large
spells.sourceTarget: Four adjacent 5-foot squares in either a straight line or a square

spells.name: Shield, Flexible, Lesser

spells.name: Shield, Vehicular, Small
spells.sourceTarget: One vehicle of Huge size or smaller

spells.name: Shield, Vehicular, Large
spells.requirements: Greater Group Shield, Small Vehicular Shield
spells.sourceTarget: One vehicle of Gargantuan size or smaller

spells.name: Shield, Vehicular, Starship

spells.name: Skin of Bronze
spells.requirements: Standard Elemental Resistance, Skin of Wood

spells.name: Skin of Iron
spells.requirements: Greater Elemental Resistance, Skin of Bronze

spells.name: Control Conflagration
spells.sourceTarget: Up to five 5-foot squares of flames (4 for weak aptitudes, 6 for primaries)

spells.name: Destruction

spells.name: Destruction, Greater

spells.name: Destruction, Total

spells.name: Elemental Storm

spells.name: Fireball, Artillery
spells.sourceRange: Long to line of sight only

spells.name: Ice Shards
spells.sourceTarget: Cone extending from the mage’s hand

spells.name: Icy Item

spells.name: Lightning Bolt, Chain
spells.sourceTarget: Up to 4 creatures (3 for weaknesses, 5 for primaries)

spells.name: Napalm Burst

spells.name: Thunderbolt

spells.name: Conjure Daemon, Greater

spells.name: Cone of Gravity

spells.name: Gravity Platform
